The '''Deputy Mayor of Vurahi''' is the deputy head of the local government of [[Vurahi]], [[Areoix Lie]]; currently that government takes the form of the [[City of Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality]].

The [[Deputy Mayor of Vurahi]] is elected by the Vurahi City Council and serves alongside the [[Mayor of Vurahi]]. The Deputy Mayor has a term length five years and can be renewed once. The position holds many duties stated in the Municipal Structures Act, such as serving as acting Mayor of Vurahi and appointing an interim Mayoral Committee in the event of the Mayor's absence, resignation, death or removal.

The current Deputy Mayor is [[Otilues marones]] of the [[DAEL]], who was elected to the role on  12th 1758. He replaced [[Carlin Affgan]], who is also from the [[DAEL]] and was elected in 1748, succeeding [[Grant Haskin]] of the [[DAEL]]. He did not seek another term in 1748.
